flow_ref: User story (not in the flow deck OCMS)
code_summary: No Letter of Advice (LoA) code in the six repos: no LoA approval list, no settled/executed filter, no LoA PDF. Only an i18n menu label, a warrant TypeScript type and a notice search by warrant_no without a backend exist. CAS endpoints (CasIntegrationController) are not credited because no step matches.
note: Story status is blank in stories.json (requirement not given / status blank); traced normally. This story follows OCMS27.20 (officer approves the list of LoA notices and defendants); that list does not exist in code so there is nothing to filter. No relevant maintenance ticket (grep warrant, advice, mention, court, arrest in maintenance_tickets.csv; OCMS-SR-2026-043 and OCMS-DF-2026-029 only concern payment acceptance of court notices, not LoA).
recommendation: Do not claim. The LoA feature (approval list, exclusion of settled/executed notices, PDF) does not exist in code.

steps.step: Officer has approved the list of notices and defendants for sending Letter of Advice
steps.detail: There is no LoA approval page, route, API, table or status. Searched synonyms warrant, letter of advice, LoA, arrest, execut*, mention, settle in the UI and API of all six repos: only an i18n menu label (ocmsadminui/src/i18n/en/translation.json:120-123), a TypeScript type ocmsadminui/src/utils/models/Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:1-12 and a notice search by warrant_no (ocmsadminui/src/pages/NoticeSearch/hook/useSearch.ts:68-78, endpoint warrantofarrest). The /v1/warrantofarrest endpoint is only listed in ocmsadminapi/src/main/resources/api-authorization.properties:23; there is no controller/entity/repository for it in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi, so cannot verify from repo whether an implementation exists elsewhere. The precondition of this story (OCMS27.20) does not exist in code.

steps.step: System determines which notices in the list are already settled or have an executed warrant
steps.detail: No settled/executed check against an LoA list exists. The nearest candidate is only the payment_status FULL_PAYMENT check when CAS calls casUpdateCourtNotices (CasIntegrationServiceImpl.java:336, rejects an already Paid notice) and casGetPaymentStatus (CasIntegrationController.java:42); these are CAS inbound endpoints for court notices, not a filter on an LoA list, so they are not credited. A 'warrant executed' status has no backend field (outcome_of_warrant exists only in the UI type ocmsadminui/src/utils/models/Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:7).

steps.step: Settled/executed notices are excluded from the list before the PDF file is produced
steps.detail: No exclusion logic exists because there is no LoA list and no LoA PDF generator. Searched synonyms warrant, letter of advice, LoA, arrest, execut*, mention, settle in the UI and API of all six repos: only an i18n menu label (ocmsadminui/src/i18n/en/translation.json:120-123), a TypeScript type ocmsadminui/src/utils/models/Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:1-12 and a notice search by warrant_no (ocmsadminui/src/pages/NoticeSearch/hook/useSearch.ts:68-78, endpoint warrantofarrest). The /v1/warrantofarrest endpoint is only listed in ocmsadminapi/src/main/resources/api-authorization.properties:23; there is no controller/entity/repository for it in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi, so cannot verify from repo whether an implementation exists elsewhere.

steps.step: The PDF interfaced to the vendor for printing and postage contains only the remaining notices
steps.detail: There is no LoA PDF. The existing PDF-to-Toppan pipeline (ToppanUploadJob.java:326-338, AnLetterPdfService.generateAnLetterPdf) is specific to AN (Advisory Notice) letters, not LoA, so it is not credited. SFTP upload to Toppan is also blocked by sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/resources/application-prod.properties:86); the real server value cannot be verified from the repo.
